description:
The SEI helps advance software engineering principles and practices and serves as a national resource in software engineering, computer security, and process improvement. The SEI works closely with defense and government organizations, industry, and academia to continually improve software-intensive systems. Our core purpose is to help organizations improve software engineering capabilities and develop or acquire the right software, defect free, within budget and on time, every time. 
  
The CERT Division of the Software Engineering Institute (SEI) is seeking applicants for an Associate AI/ML Communications Research Engineer.  In this role, a successful candidate will employ a multi-discipline approach to investigate, design, and validate AI/ML models and systems with application to wireless communications systems and protocols. This position requires knowledge of the design, training, and test of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Temporal Neural Networks (TNN).  This position requires knowledge of signal processing methods and techniques applied to the physical layer of wireless communications devices with emphasis on detection, modulation, and spreading. This position requires strong professional and team environment skills. 
   
 The SEI is a federally funded research and development center at Carnegie Mellon University. 
  
What you’ll do:  
 ·       Design, train, and test ANNs and TNNs using the latest tools and methods. 
 Analyze and assess performance of radio frequency (RF) receivers.
 Research novel approaches to sensing the RF channel and optimizing the communications link.
 Program in C/C++ in an embedded Linux environment.
 Perform system analysis in MATLAB and Python.
 Develop logic in Verilog and SystemVerilog for System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms.
 Design and maintain physical and virtual test environments.
 Automate data collection and testing processes.
  
 Who you are:
 You have an MS in Electrical Engineering or related field, with at least one year of relevant experience. 
 You have a deep interest in AI / ML and the application to RF systems and protocols.
 You have practical experience with design and evaluation of AI and ML systems.
 You have penchant for intellectual curiosity, enjoy working on a small team of engineers, and have a desire to make an impact beyond your organization.
 You are hands and enjoy creating and testing prototypes.
 You have experience with laboratory test equipment.
 You have strong teamwork skills especially with working in interdisciplinary teams with professionals from other fields in a multi-tasking environment.
 You have superb communication skills (oral and written), particularly regarding technical communications with non-experts
 You have a strong desire to learn and take on dynamic new challenges applying your existing skills and developing new skills
  
 You are able to:
 Travel to various locations to support the SEI’s overall mission. This includes within the SEI and CMU community, mission partner sites, conferences, and offsite meetings on occasion (10%).
 You will be subject to a background check and will need to obtain and maintain a Department of War security clearance.
